rules.content:
title: Mshta Launched With Remote HTA URL
id: 16238dfd-9719-5274-ab7c-d755d4c05eb6
status: experimental
description: Detects mshta.exe started with an http or https URL on its command line, as used by the DuskRelay
  loader to fetch and run a remote HTA file.
references:
- urn:atidep:TI-2026-0001
author: ATIDEP
date: 2026/10/22
tags:
- attack.stealth
- attack.t1218.005
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_img:
    Image|endswith: \mshta.exe
  selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains:
    - http://
    - https://
  condition: selection_img and selection_cli
falsepositives:
- Legitimate internal HTA applications hosted on an intranet web server
level: high

opportunities.concept: mshta.exe launched with a remote http or https URL argument
opportunities.reason: Three independent victims show the same mshta.exe launch with a remote URL, and the command line is directly observable in process creation telemetry.
